meta.title: Decision-readiness register - one row per requirement in the owner brief
meta.rules: Statuses describe this repository, not the league. A value that cannot be established from a committed artefact or a dated official read is left blank with the reason named. Rows marked BLOCKED-DECISION are reviewer questions; this build implements none of them.

rows.requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.blocking_gate: No permitted market-price source: the NFL's betting feed is distributed to operators through an exclusive distributor, so market open and close are null on every row (Line Desk FL-LD-02). The second end of our own movement has never been captured because no post-kickoff capture is scheduled.
rows.clears_when: One full slate with both ends of both series: market open AND close non-null on 42 rows (14 games x 3 markets) and our open AND close non-null on the same 42. Today: our open 45/45, our close 0, market open 0, market close 0, complete pairs 0.
rows.measured_now: Price Store (official-only) holds 0 rows. Price Desk holds 2364 game-market rows and 11370 prop rows with 0 opens; its 22 official-score games sit beside 931 archived-unverified and 135 missing scores in its results feed.

evidence.label: NFL.com - Genius Sports exclusive betting-data distribution (read 2026-11-14, line-desk)

rows.next_action: Reviewer rules on the price policy (RR-A9); meanwhile schedule a pre-kickoff and a post-kickoff capture of OUR OWN lines so at least one slate has both ends.

rows.requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.blocking_gate: Coverage, not method: the Line Desk feed holds 44 finals (Weeks 7,8,9,10); Weeks 1-6 are listed pending with blank scores, so a season-long backtest cannot be called official-backed end to end.
rows.clears_when: 272 of 272 regular-season finals, each row carrying its own official game-centre URL and zero mismatch against the committed snapshot. Added at this capture: 14 of 14 Week-10 finals read first-hand (1 of them also on its game centre).
rows.measured_now: Line Desk cross-check reported 27/27 rows matching the committed snapshot for the overlap it had.

evidence.label: NFL.com Week 10 schedule and finals - read 2026-11-18

rows.next_action: Extend the same one-row-per-fixture transcription backwards to Weeks 1-6 from the official weekly schedule pages.

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.blocking_gate: Nothing blocks the ordering; the numbers it publishes stay blank where no market price exists.
rows.clears_when: Order asserted by a check on every build for every slate. Today: fixed and published for a 15-game slate, with the sign convention (positive = home favoured) verified on all 15 rows.
rows.measured_now: side -> total -> moneyline, published in that order.

evidence.label: Line Desk - origination order and slate

rows.next_action: Keep the order pinned so a later refactor cannot silently re-sort it.

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.blocking_gate: Two of the three columns have no permitted input; they are blank by policy rather than estimated.
rows.clears_when: Three non-null columns on 42/42 rows of one slate. Today: all three columns exist on 45 rows, with market line and difference null on all of them.
rows.measured_now: Fair line published on every row; market line and residual blank with the reason on the page.

evidence.label: Line Desk - origination order and slate

rows.next_action: Publish the residual as soon as RR-A1 and RR-A9 clear.

rows.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
rows.blocking_gate: Our half of the residual exists on a schedule; the market half has no source this project may use.
rows.clears_when: Residual published for 14/14 fixtures of a slate, three times a week. Today: 0 residuals, because the market column is null on every row.

evidence.label: NFL.com - Genius Sports exclusive betting-data distribution (read 2026-11-14, line-desk)

rows.next_action: Either license a permitted price feed or narrow the published residual to our own open-to-close movement, labelled as not a market residual.

rows.requirement: Vig-free market consensus vs originated fair-line decomposition view
rows.blocking_gate: Separating vig from divergence needs at least two independent operator quotes per market; the project holds zero operator quotes.
rows.clears_when: >=2 quotes per market on one slate (84 quotes across 42 markets), overround computed from the pair and the consensus shown net of vig.

evidence.label: NFL.com - Genius Sports exclusive betting-data distribution (read 2026-11-14, line-desk)

rows.next_action: Decide whether operator consensus may be displayed at all before building the view.

rows.requirement: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
rows.blocking_gate: The root ratings are opponent-aware but are computed from a community nflverse extract, not from a league-published feed; only part of the 2026 slate has been reconciled against official pages, so the rows are labelled third-party.
rows.clears_when: Every game in the published window reconciled to an official final. This capture: 14 Week-10 finals verified first-hand; Line Desk reports 27/27 for its overlap. Root prediction rows: 936.
rows.measured_now: Model MAE 10.391 pts vs market MAE 9.711 pts (walk-forward), so the opponent-aware ratings still lose to the close.
rows.next_action: Reconcile the extract season by season against the official week pages, then relabel only the reconciled rows.

rows.requirement: Turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus
rows.blocking_gate: Two upstream gates: the price-data policy (RR-A9) and hash-frozen strategy definitions (RR-B6). A corpus built on a third-party price archive would inherit the very dispute it is meant to settle.
rows.clears_when: 136 games x (frozen rule hash, per-game price pair, chronological split) published as one immutable corpus whose commit hash is recorded before evaluation. Today: no such corpus file exists at root.

evidence.label: NFL.com - Genius Sports exclusive betting-data distribution (read 2026-11-14, line-desk)

rows.next_action: Reviewer ruling first; then freeze the corpus and compute from it exactly once.

rows.requirement: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published
rows.blocking_gate: This is a reviewer decision, not an engineering gap: no ruling is recorded on the board or on the site. Options in evidence: (a) no prices - probability-only scoring; (b) third-party archived closes, labelled third-party and used for nothing but ranking sanity; (c) a licensed vendor.
rows.clears_when: One recorded ruling (option, date, commit hash) plus the label wording it authorises. Today: 0 rulings.
rows.next_action: Put the three options to the reviewer as this row; keep every backtest page gated until it lands.

rows.requirement: Store every model output as a probability plus its inputs, not just a pick
rows.blocking_gate: The root prediction table stores margins, totals and the settled outcome; it has no probability column and no input snapshot, so a published pick cannot be re-derived from the row.
rows.clears_when: 100% of published predictions carry (p, model version, input hash). Today: 936 rows with columns [season,week,game_id,home_team,away_team,model_margin,model_total,market_margin,market_total,result,total]; probability column: no; input/hash column: no.
rows.measured_now: Line Desk origination rows do publish a probability per game alongside the fair line, without the input vector.

evidence.label: Line Desk - origination order and slate

rows.next_action: Add model_version and input_hash to the prediction writer and make the probability the primary published field.

rows.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.blocking_gate: Nothing blocks the split; what blocks promotion is qualification.
rows.clears_when: Rank must be invariant to the staking block. Demonstrated on the published board: the best staking rank sits 5th of 7 on signal, and the best signal rank sits 3rd on staking.
rows.measured_now: 0 of 7 candidates qualified on signal; root board lists 9 entries with 0 approved.

evidence.label: Line Desk - signal vs staking leaderboard

rows.next_action: Keep staking out of the ranking function; the existing test is the guard.

rows.requirement: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate (Brier skill, game-cluster bound, multiplicity)
rows.blocking_gate: Nothing blocks the method; the sample is short, which is exactly what the method reports.
rows.clears_when: Every ranked row shows benchmark-relative skill, a game-cluster bootstrap bound and an adjusted p with the trial count. Today: all three are published per row.
rows.measured_now: 0 strategies qualify; expected-maximum-of-k statistics published with k.

evidence.label: NIST Dataplot aid - correlation confidence limits (Fisher z)

rows.next_action: Re-rank on the frozen holdout once RR-A9 clears; do not re-mine for a significant slice.

rows.requirement: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions (singles, game parlays, same-game parlays, prop combos)
rows.blocking_gate: Three of four divisions have no eligible entrant: parlays and prop combos sit behind the joint-evidence gate (RR-D2) and every division waits on the price ruling (RR-A9).
rows.clears_when: At least one eligible entrant per division with skill score and interval. Today: singles populated, other three divisions empty by rule.
rows.next_action: Keep the empty divisions published with the blocking gate named, rather than collapsing them.

rows.requirement: Add a control baseline (random picks; favourites only) to every leaderboard run
rows.blocking_gate: None.
rows.clears_when: Two controls in every run, excluded from the candidate count. Today: 7 candidates and 2 controls on the Line Desk board.

evidence.label: Line Desk - signal vs staking leaderboard

rows.next_action: Add the closing line as a third control if a price source is ever licensed.

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.blocking_gate: There is nothing to demote yet: no strategy is live, so the gate has only been exercised in a dry run.
rows.clears_when: D-outcome fires at n >= 200 decided picks with a one-sided 95% ROI upper bound below 0; D-integrity holds on any missing-data failure. Dry run today: 0 promoted, 0 demoted, all candidates PAPER.
rows.measured_now: State machine published with thresholds labelled PROPOSED.

evidence.label: Line Desk - promotion and demotion gates

rows.next_action: Reviewer sets the thresholds; after that the gate is mechanical.

rows.requirement: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from ever appearing on the leaderboard
rows.blocking_gate: Definitions are committed, but not frozen before evaluation, so the board cannot honestly claim its entries were pre-registered; the hub registers label the practice as proposed.
rows.clears_when: 100% of leaderboard entries carry (rule text, sample window, gates, freeze hash) committed before the window opens. Today: 35 definitions in the origination registry, 0 with a recorded freeze hash.
rows.measured_now: Backtest numbers are kept off the leaderboard: the published board shows gate outcomes and skill scores, with ROI in a separate, unranked block.
rows.next_action: Freeze the registry in a tagged commit, record the hash per entry, and fail the build when an entry's window starts before its hash.

rows.requirement: Freeze a rule before it sees data (the commit hash is the registration)
rows.blocking_gate: The mechanism does not exist at root: no freeze-hash field in the register the site renders, and no CI check on the ordering of freeze versus window.
rows.clears_when: Every rule row shows a short commit hash and its date, and CI fails if the hash is missing or later than the window start. Today: 0 rows hash-frozen.
rows.next_action: Implement as a two-column registry (rule text, freeze hash) validated in CI; it costs one schema change.

rows.requirement: Add a two-sided 'what would change our mind' field to every strategy entry
rows.blocking_gate: The field exists as a proposal in the Review Board programme layer, but it is not a required column of the strategy schema, so entries can still be published without it.
rows.clears_when: 100% of strategy entries carry BOTH a promote-if and a demote-if numeric threshold. Today: 0 of 35 registry rows carry a threshold pair.
rows.measured_now: The demotion gate supplies the negative side at gate level (RR-B5), not at entry level.

evidence.label: Line Desk - promotion and demotion gates

rows.next_action: Add the fields to the schema and fail the build when either side is empty.

rows.requirement: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
rows.blocking_gate: Nothing blocks the split. What limits it: an earlier audit recorded a holdout look in one hub, which is why no result is called validated.
rows.clears_when: Holdout touched exactly once per frozen rule, with the touch recorded. Today: walk-forward evaluation with a holdout sigma per hub and no touch log.
rows.next_action: Record holdout touches in the registry so 'looked at once' is auditable rather than remembered.

rows.requirement: Two-stage skill leaderboard: proper-score qualification, then prospective CLV/ROI escrow
rows.blocking_gate: Stage 2 needs paired prices (RR-A1, RR-A5), so the escrow clock cannot start.
rows.clears_when: At least 200 prospective settled picks per escrowed strategy with open and close pairs. Today: 0 escrowed strategies (0 qualified at stage 1 as well).
rows.measured_now: Stage 1 qualification published per entry; nobody passes.

evidence.label: Line Desk - signal vs staking leaderboard

rows.next_action: If the reviewer rules prices out, start the escrow on probability error instead of ROI.

rows.requirement: Treat it as a leaderboard competition that provides rewards for top performing strategies
rows.blocking_gate: No funded pool, no jurisdiction or licensing determination, and zero qualifying strategies. Rewards are a design schedule, not a promise.
rows.clears_when: A funded amount, a jurisdiction ruling and at least one qualifying strategy must all exist before any reward row is non-zero. Today: 0 / 0 / 0.

evidence.label: Line Desk - signal vs staking leaderboard

rows.next_action: Reviewer decides whether rewards are displayed at all while qualification is zero.

rows.requirement: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline (pre-registered team-strength model, frozen versions, forecasts recorded before kickoff)
rows.blocking_gate: Forecasts have only ever been published for settled slates; a shadow baseline needs a dated record written BEFORE the first kickoff it predicts.
rows.clears_when: One full slate (14 games) whose forecast commit timestamp precedes the earliest kickoff, graded afterwards. Today: 0 pre-kickoff slates recorded.
rows.measured_now: The team-strength model exists and its walk-forward accuracy is published, which is the input the shadow baseline needs.

evidence.label: Line Desk - origination order and slate

rows.next_action: Cheapest unblock in this register: freeze the Week-11 forecasts before kickoff, then grade them.

rows.requirement: Build the availability graph as a first-class dataset (who was expected to start, who actually did)

rows.clears_when: 32 of 32 clubs with dated availability rows, game-day starter/inactive evidence and a confirmation link per edge. Today: 11 rows, 0 replacement names, 0 string tiers; this capture adds 12 rows across 4 clubs read first-hand.
rows.measured_now: Official report columns re-confirmed: Player, Position, Injuries, Practice Status, Game Status - and nothing else.

evidence.label: NFL.com official injury report Week 10 - read 2026-11-18

rows.next_action: Wire the per-fixture Game Book (RR-C5) in as the confirmation side of the graph.

rows.blocking_gate: Playing time is in no source this project holds: NFL.com team depth paths return 404, the weekly report has no snap column, and community snap counts are third-party.
rows.clears_when: Snap-share rows for 14/14 fixtures of a slate from an authorised source, with the starter/backup split derived from snaps only. Today: 0 fixtures.

evidence.label: NFL.com official injury report Week 10 - read 2026-11-18

rows.next_action: Licence a snap source or parse the official Game Books the game centres link (RR-C5/RR-C6).

rows.clears_when: Every designation row becomes (observed status, expected play rate, residual). Needs the designation-reliability table on n >= 1,000 designations with intervals.

evidence.label: NFL.com official injury report Week 10 - read 2026-11-18

rows.next_action: Run RR-C9 first; the surprise is a derived field, not a new source.

rows.clears_when: 32 of 32 clubs with a dated roster and IR row set, each with a per-club count and hash, before any team-level output is labelled stronger than a benchmark. Today: 4/32 clubs, 12 rows.

evidence.label: NFL.com official injury report Week 10 - read 2026-11-18

rows.next_action: Batch the sweep as one job with a per-club assertion so a short read fails instead of publishing a partial table.
